messages:
claire: Quick idea for the HW + marketplace private offer we discussed — want quick feedback before EOD. Thinking of a 'commit velocity' structure to encourage fast consumption and protect renewal cadence.

sujay: curious, what does 'commit velocity' look like in practice?

claire: two options: 1) Upfront bucket with 12mo commit but velocity tiers that unlock extra HW credit if usage hits X% of commit in first 90 days. 2) Ramping commit: smaller initial commit, automatic step-ups at 90/180 days if previous tier is hit (with pro-rata HW credits).

kevin: high level numbers please — need to model unit economics.

claire: rough sketch: 
```
Offer A (Upfront): commit $1.2M over 12mo. If 90-day consumption >= 30% of total commit -> +5% HW credit applied to year 1 invoices. If 90-day >= 50% -> +10% HW credit + SI onboarding credit $25k.
Offer B (Ramping): Q1 commit $200k, auto-step to Q2 $300k if Q1 >= 80% -> step-up triggers 3% HW credit; final step to full $1.2M only if both steps hit.
```

claire: main goals: (a) accelerate true usage so customers lock into model, (b) align HW partner incentives via percentage-based credit, (c) avoid big renewal cliff if they underconsume early.

kevin: net margin calc quick note — HW credits need to be structured as reimbursements tied to invoice usage not as pre-paid discounts. Otherwise accounting treats as contra-revenue and it eats into committed recognition.

ashley: legal flag — make sure step-up automation is explicit and signed: autopilot increments must be opt-in at signature or we add a 14-day cancellation window post-step. Also clarify data portability if they step down.

claire: good call. we'll add explicit opt-in checkbox and an opt-out window.

sujay: from SI side — prefer smaller initial commit + guaranteed SI kickoff credit that vests after first successful integration milestone. SI partners want certainty; a percent-of-commit HW credit that flows to partner co-selling fund is ideal.

claire: proposed flow for partner fund: marketplace pushes credit SKU to partner account on hit of threshold -> partner redeems against co-sell expenses. Something like: `credit.sku.hw_partner.{partner_id}` 

marketplace-bot: New private-offer template created: PO-commit-velocity-v1. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/offers/PO-commit-velocity-v1

kevin: can devex/finance run a 3-scenario model (conservative, base, aggressive) on margin + cash flow for both offers? If conservative shows >8% contribution margin after credits we're fine.

claire: will do. sujay, ashley — can you two review the customer-facing doc and SI credit flow by Thu? I want to brief Cloud partner on Friday for joint announcement window the following week.

sujay: can do.

ashley: on it.

claire: thanks team — plan: finish legal & finance sign-off Thu, prep co-announcement draft Fri, target marketplace listing/PO upload next Mon. :rocket:
